title: Localized first projection is a ring equivalence.
statement: Under the hypotheses of puncturedMap_basicOpen_appTop_bijective, there exists a ring equivalence between the section rings of the restricted model and punctured source whose underlying function is the displayed appTop hom.

proof.text: Set B = D.matchingRing, r = D.baseMap(f), and W to the displayed model chart. The composite open immersion j:W to Spec B has image D(r): use Scheme.Hom.comp_image, Opens.ι_image_top, image_morphismRestrict_preimage, image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, hf, and SpecMap_preimage_basicOpen. Transport the Mathlib localization of Γ(Spec B,D(r)) along j.appIso(top) to Γ(W,top). The compatibility of its B-algebra map with ΓSpecIso.inv followed by j.appTop follows by appLE_appIso_inv and presheaf functoriality. These are the two proved private helpers of this module.

Let rho:B to Γ(W,top) be this algebra map and psi the displayed restricted appTop hom. Give the target the B-algebra structure psi composed with rho. Powers of r map to units, since they are units in Γ(W,top). The chart-power-lift theorem supplies the denominator-surjectivity axiom. Apply the chart-kernel-torsion theorem to b-c to supply the equality-clearing axiom. Thus the target is also a localization of B at the powers of r.

Apply Mathlib IsLocalization.bijective to psi between these two localizations; its algebra-map compatibility is reflexivity. RingEquiv.ofBijective psi constructs the required ring equivalence, with the asserted equality of underlying functions by reflexivity.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0BLH and 05ER, localized chart comparison; explicit Mathlib localization and ring-hom combination proved in Lean, geometric denominator lifting and kernel torsion split off.

theorem exists_puncturedMap_basicOpen_appTop_ringEquiv
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme} [IsFinite q]
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))} [IsFinite s]
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) (f : A)
    (hf : (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f : (Spec (.of A)).Opens) ≤ U) :
    ∃ e : Γ(((D.modelMap ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ
        (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)).toScheme, ⊤) ≃+*
        Γ((D.puncturedMap ⁻¹ᵁ ((D.modelMap ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ
          (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))).toScheme, ⊤),
      (e : _ → _) =
        (D.puncturedMap ∣_ ((D.modelMap ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ
          (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))).appTop.hom
